subject: PO allocation discrepancy — EverFlux (PO 2026-11-EF42)
messages:
From: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@everflux.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: finance@everflux.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: PO 2026-11-EF42 vs Nov usage — allocation mismatch

Hi Rishi,

We're reconciling November and noticed a discrepancy between the PO we issued (PO 2026-11-EF42, committed amount $90,000 excl VAT) and the usage billed on our November invoice. Your metering showed ~2.4M tokens attributed to our account after the PO applied, but the invoice indicates ~2.7M tokens (a $8,400 delta before VAT).

Can you help us understand:
- How those extra tokens were attributed to our account (appears to be a tenant attribution / prefix issue)
- Whether Redwood can provisionally apply a credit or hold collection on the overage while you investigate
- If any VAT handling differs when we apply a retroactive credit (we're EU entity charged VAT on the original invoice)

I've attached an export from our end (everflux_usage_nov_export.csv) showing session_ids and timestamps — happy to hop on a short call if that helps. We need confirmation for our internal PO reconciliation and to advise procurement.

Thanks,
Lina Zhao
Head of Finance, EverFlux Analytics
Attachment: everflux_usage_nov_export.csv (CSV, 124KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@everflux.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PO 2026-11-EF42 vs Nov usage — allocation mismatch

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and the CSV, received.

Short answer: we will investigate attribution and can temporarily hold collection on the disputed amount while we validate. Next steps from our side:
1) Billing will reconcile token attribution (prefix/tenant tags) against our ingestion logs for 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30.
2) Engineering will look at any cross-tenant routing anomalies if tokens appear to have been misattributed.
3) Finance/Billing will provisionally issue a credit memo for the confirmed overage (we'll exclude VAT on the credit amount and provide guidance on VAT reversal).

Can you send the PO PDF and confirm the exact VAT registration entity? I'll set up a 30-minute call Monday to go through the export if that works — Ben and Marissa are on the thread to coordinate credits and collections holds.

Proposed times (ET): Mon 2026-11-23 10:00 / 11:00 / 15:00 — which works for you?

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Internal: EverFlux PO mismatch — provisional approach

Rishi/Marissa — quick internal alignment before the call:
- Preliminary read: delta looks like ~300k tokens (~$8.4k net) and likely attribution tagging drift; engineering to confirm.
- Approve provisional credit equal to the net delta (exclude VAT) and open BILL-1124 ticket for collection hold + credit memo issuance.
- Marissa: can you prepare a credit memo draft and hold collections? If we confirm misattribution we'll finalize and process reversal of VAT with the tax team.
- If engineering finds no misattribution, escalate back to EverFlux with detailed evidence and propose a one-off reconciliation.

I'll join the call at 11:00 ET.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@everflux.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: PO 2026-11-EF42 vs Nov usage — allocation mismatch

Hi Lina — thanks again for the PO and the VT details. Follow-up from our side after a quick triage and the call:

1) We've applied a provisional credit memo of $8,400 net (PO delta) to your account pending full log reconciliation. That credit excludes VAT; we will issue a separate VAT reversal instruction if the credit is finalized (our tax team will confirm the mechanism for your EU VAT registration).
2) Collections: we have placed a temporary hold on the disputed collection item (BILL-1124). No action will be taken until we complete the engineering verification (ETA 3 business days).
3) Engineering is tracing token attribution windows and will provide a session-level mapping report. If misattribution is confirmed, we'll keep the credit and retroactively correct records. If not, we'll share evidence and request a follow-up payment for the validated amount.

Next steps on our side: Marissa will follow up with the provisional credit memo PDF and a short note on VAT handling; Ben will ensure the contract/PO applies correctly against the committed credits. Lina — appreciate it if you can confirm the billing contact (finance@everflux.com) will accept the provisional memo for internal reconciliation.

Rishi
Attachment: provisional_credit_note_everflux_20261124.pdf (PDF, 6KB)
